description: Reference solution - DSC-QUAL-009 is addressed by DSC-MAINT-001 comprehensive service decomposition
approach: DSC-QUAL-009 (SRP violation in 1202-line service) is the same underlying issue as DSC-MAINT-001 (monolithic service with 6+ responsibilities). The comprehensive solution in DSC-MAINT-001 fully addresses this issue by decomposing AkshareService into 6 focused services: CatalogService, SchedulerService, HttpClientService, ParserService, PersistenceService, and StatusService.

tasks.title: Apply DSC-MAINT-001 Solution
tasks.description: This issue is fully addressed by implementing DSC-MAINT-001. No additional tasks required.
implementation: Execute DSC-MAINT-001 solution which decomposes the 1202-line monolithic service
Result: 6 focused services each with single responsibility
